purpose: Bridge retrospective environmental response evidence to decision-time-safe 10/20/30 minute HRRR forecast scenarios.

important_semantics.score: Environment-conditional improvement propensity. It is not yet the final P(beat_current_result).
important_semantics.forecast: Only decision-time-safe HRRR scenarios from R4P5 are used.
important_semantics.track_temperature: Historical track-temperature response may be analysed diagnostically, but track temperature is excluded from prospective scoring because HRRR does not forecast track-surface temperature.
important_semantics.queue: No queue waiting-time distribution is applied in this phase.
important_semantics.strategy: No STOP / RETAIN / WITHDRAW action recommendation is made.
